resources.string:
1. The launcher icon becomes "%1$s" and opens an ordinary web page. Some launchers move the icon off the home screen; drag it back from the app list.

2. To get in: at the top of the page, pull down and hold for about %2$s s until you feel a light vibration, then release and verify with your fingerprint or screen lock.

3. After you tap Enable the app closes right away; from then on it can only be opened from "%1$s". The app also locks again when it goes to the background or the screen turns off, which also stops background playback.
